items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The team recently opened up Lambert-Smith's 21-day practice window. He was able to participate in a limited fashion on Wednesday, and there's a chance that he will suit up and play in Week 6, though we won't know if that will be the case or not until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thompson was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. If he's active in Week 6, he could see more work than usual with Ladd McConkey (foot), Tre Harris' (hamstring), and Quentin Johnston (chest) all uncertain to play for the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he was left limited by a rib issue of some kind. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, regardless of his injury status heading into Week 6.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McConkey was unable to see any real action last week due to his foot issue. He was able to practice on Wednesday to start the week this week, but he remained limited due to the same injury. He may play through it in Week 6, but it's hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him at this point in the season, even if his health is improving.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Kolar (arm) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar (arm) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end made his return to the lineup in Week 4 after missing a couple of weeks with a forearm injury. He looked good and is now a full participant at practice, so fantasy managers can safely speculate that he is back to close health at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Quentin Johnston (chest) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Johnston was not able to play last week due to a chest injury that he's dealing with. He was able to practice on Wednesday, however, which is a good sign that he will be back for Week 6. If he's active, he may see more work than usual if Tre' Harris (hamstring) or Ladd McConkey (foot) are ruled out for Sunday's game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tre' Harris (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tre' Harris (hamstring) officially did not take part in Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harris is considered week-to-week with a hamstring injury right now, so it's no surprise that he was sidelined at practice on Wednesday. Fantasy managers should look for Quentin Johnston (chest) to see a bit more work if the young wideout is sidelined this week.
